summary: Intervening Spirit (#1312): tested as a Home Battle action for the Attacker and the Defender with no presence at the battlefield (free and bowed Personality, Shugenja at home) -- it works. Fixed two defects: with no enemy unit at the battlefield it was offered as playable and then refused on submit (now not offered); if the enemy left during a reaction window resolution refused instead of fizzling (now fizzles, issue #967's shape). Water Shugenja + Ancestor target grants an additional Battle action that keeps priority and is spendable.
validation: New InterveningSpiritTests (4 cases) pass; the no-enemy case fails without the fix. battle-absent-moves 8/8. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: see PR.
remaining: Rules question for Mendon: the printed bonus says Ancestor; no deck-playable Personality has the Ancestor keyword (the six Spirit Personalities do not), only the created Lion Ancestor. Spirit-only targets get no bonus as printed; unchanged pending a ruling.
